input_type.title: Input Type
input_type.description: Select whether inputting bam as a file or a directory.

bam_file.title: bam - file
bam_file.description: Path to a single BAM file.

bam_directory.title: bam - directory
bam_directory.description: Specify a subdirectory containing BAM files. Eg. if dataset/bam_folder/*.bam, enter `bam_folder`

ref.title: Reference Genome
ref.description: Path to the reference genome file.

bed.title: bed
bed.description: An optional BED file enumerating regions to process for variant calling.

sv.title: sv
sv.description: Run structural variant calling using Sniffles2.

snp.title: snp
snp.description: Run small variant calling using Clair3.

cnv.title: cnv
cnv.description: Run copy number variant calling using Spectre (default) or QDNAseq.

str.title: str
str.description: Run genotyping of STR expansions using Straglr (hg38 genome only).

mod.title: mod
mod.description: Enable modified calls to a bedMethyl file with modkit.

use_qdnaseq.title: Use QDNAseq for CNV
use_qdnaseq.description: Enable CNV calling using QDNAseq instead of Spectre.

str_options.description: Short tandem repeat expansion genotyping options

sex.title: Sex to be passed to Straglr-genotype for calling chrX repeats. If not specified, workflow will infer XX/XY based on allosome coverage.

force_strand.title: Force Strand
force_strand.description: Require modkit to call strand-aware modifications.

bam_min_coverage.title: bam_min_coverage
bam_min_coverage.description: Minimum read coverage required to run analysis. Setting to 0 will skip checking read coverage, proceeding directly to downstream analyses.

phased.title: Perform phasing
phased.description: Enable phasing of sv, snp, and/or mod workflows.

override_basecaller_cfg.title: override_basecaller_cfg
override_basecaller_cfg.description: The workflow will attempt to find the basecaller model from the headers of your input data. Providing a value for this option will override the model found in the data. If the model cannot be found in the header, it must be provided with this option to conduct small variant calling.

output_gene_summary.title: Generate gene-level coverage summaries.
output_gene_summary.description: If enabled, a 4-column BED file must be supplied, where column 4 is the gene label. The workflow will generate a list of all genes in the BED and their percentage coverage at a range of thresholds (1x, 10x, 15x, 20x, and 30x), as well as the average coverage of each gene.

include_all_ctgs.title: Include all contigs
include_all_ctgs.description: Call for variants on all contigs of the input reference sequence. Typically not required, but may be useful for non-standard reference sequence databases.

depth_intervals.title: Output a bedGraph file with entries for each genomic interval featuring homogeneous depth.
depth_intervals.description: The output bedGraph file will have an entry for each genomic interval in which all positions have the same alignment depth. By default this workflow outputs summary depth information from your aligned reads. Per-base depth outputs are slower to generate but may be required for some downstream applications.

GVCF.title: Output a gVCF file in addition to the VCF outputs (experimental).
GVCF.description: A VCF file containing only records where a variant has been detected is produced by default. Enabling this option will also output a gVCF with records spanning all reference positions regardless of whether a variant was detected in the sample.

output_xam_fmt.title: File format of alignment files created by alignment and phasing.
output_xam_fmt.description: This setting controls the file format of (1) alignment files created by aligning or re-aligning an input BAM and (2) alignment files with haplotag information created during phasing of an input BAM. Using QDNASeq for CNV calling will automatically use BAM format.

modkit_args.title: Additional options for modkit.
modkit_args.description: Allow running modkit with custom settings. The arguments specified in this option will fully override all options set by the workflow. Provide custom arguments to modkit pileup (https://nanoporetech.github.io/modkit/advanced_usage.html#pileup) from command line as follows: `--modkit_args="--preset traditional"`

sniffles_args.title: Additional command line arguments to pass to the Sniffles2 process.
sniffles_args.description: The additional command line arguments will be passed directly to Sniffles2 (https://github.com/fritzsedlazeck/Sniffles/tree/v2.0.7); to ensure the right commands for the version and from command line, provide them as follows: `--sniffles_args="--non-germline"`.

tr_bed.title: Input BED file containing tandem repeat annotations for the reference genome.
tr_bed.description: Providing a tandem repeat BED can improve calling in repetitive regions. The workflow will attempt to select an appropriate hg19 or hg38 TR BED depending on the genome detected, but this can be overridden with a custom TR BED with this parameter.

threads.title: threads
threads.description: Set max number of threads to use for more intense processes (minimum 1, maximum 32)

ubam_map_threads.title: ubam_map_threads
ubam_map_threads.description: Set max number of threads to use for aligning reads from uBAM (minimum 1, maximum 32)

ubam_sort_threads.title: ubam_sort_threads
ubam_sort_threads.description: Set max number of threads to use for sorting and indexing aligned reads from uBAM (minimum 1, maximum 32)

ubam_bam2fq_threads.title: ubam_bam2fq_threads
ubam_bam2fq_threads.description: Set max number of threads to use for uncompressing uBAM and generating FASTQ for alignment (minimum 1, maximum 32)

modkit_threads.title: modkit_threads
modkit_threads.description: Total number of threads to use in modkit modified base calling (minimum 1, maximum 32)
